_comment: News benchmark (voice-cli actions-bench --corpus Tests/Fixtures/news-fr.json). The model gets every action tool, chercher_web and lire_nouvelles, as in the app with the actions and the web search on and a source of received information added. Cases 1-18 ask for the user's news (« Quoi de neuf ? », messages, what happened while they were away): lire_nouvelles, which takes no argument. Cases 19-30 need no tool (small talk, general knowledge, remarks about news), 31-36 the web search (the news of the world, novelties of a brand), 37-40 an action whose words are close (messages, news, « nouveau »). Reference time: Wednesday 21 October 2026, 19:30.
